The additive non-round geometry contract now preserves Cartier's exact 29.5 x 22 mm dimensions without inventing a diameter and uses the evidenced overall length as wearing span. Exact current price, 16 mm width, approximately 79.3 g maximum-bracelet weight, QuickSwitch attachment, and the absence of lume are independently reviewed. A 2026-08-31 official Spain-region recheck independently corroborates the exact High Autonomy quartz configuration and dimensions but, like the accessible Malaysia page and Cartier's movement overview, publishes no numerical rate bound or defined accuracy period. An exact-reference certified-service listing confirms an accuracy inspection occurred but supplies no result, protocol, or period. The exact-calibre monthly-accuracy query remains unanswered; generic quartz or third-party calibre assumptions remain rejected, leaving accuracy as the sole M1 gap.
